besluite.rede: The original 'bo dieselfde as onder en in die middel' is natural Afrikaans; the reorder is a lateral move.
The repeated 'word' is acceptable, and the original deliberately parallels 'Die suiker word nie self 'n vloeistof nie' two sentences later, which the change would break.

besluite.fout: 'sak daarin uit' is a stiff, technical-sounding phrase for a Grade 6 reader
besluite.rede: 'sak na die bodem' says the same thing in the plain phrase the lesson already uses, which sharpens the contrast with the insoluble substances.

besluite.fout: 'of dit na die bodem sak' after 'sien' can be read as 'whether it sinks'
besluite.rede: Repeating 'as' makes the two conditions unambiguous without changing the meaning.

besluite.fout: An adjective is defined with 'Wanneer', which reads awkwardly
besluite.rede: This is a glossary definition shared across lessons, so rewording it beyond a spelling or grammar fix belongs to the writer.
